quote: Acute gouty arthritis
note: Single-ingredient dexamethasone label lists acute gouty arthritis, a manifestation of primary gout.

quote: Ibuprofen Tablets, USP are indicated for relief of mild to moderate pain.
note: Single-ingredient ibuprofen is indicated for general mild-to-moderate pain, which covers pleuritic chest pain as a pain subtype; no co-ingredient attribution involved.

quote: For the treatment of dermatomyositis, polymyositis, and systemic lupus erythematosus.
note: Single-ingredient dexamethasone label covers dermatomyositis, of which juvenile dermatomyositis is a subtype.

quote: indicated in the treatment of hemodynamically stable patients with definite or suspected acute myocardial infarction
note: Single-ingredient metoprolol tartrate labels cover acute MI, of which anterolateral MI is a subtype.

quote: indicated for the management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic
note: Single-ingredient buprenorphine labels cover severe pain generally, which includes bone pain.

quote: BUDESONIDE AND FORMOTEROL FUMARATE DIHYDRATE INHALATION AEROSOL is indicated for the treatment of asthma
note: Single-ingredient formoterol (Perforomist) is explicitly not indicated for asthma, but the ICS/LABA combination asthma indication relies on formoterol's own LABA bronchodilator role, so it is not purely co-ingredient-derived (borderline).

quote: Psoriatic arthritis
note: Single-ingredient corticotropin label lists psoriatic arthritis under rheumatic disorders.

quote: severe erythema multiforme (Stevens-Johnson syndrome)
note: Single-ingredient prednisolone label lists severe erythema multiforme.

quote: infectious diarrhea caused by Escherichia coli (enterotoxigenic isolates), Campylobacter jejuni
note: Single-ingredient ciprofloxacin label covers Campylobacter jejuni infectious diarrhea.

quote: Nonsuppurative thyroiditis
note: Single-ingredient dexamethasone label lists nonsuppurative thyroiditis.

quote: mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) colorectal cancer (CRC) in combination with ipilimumab
note: Single-ingredient nivolumab label covers MSI-H/dMMR colorectal cancer (co-administration regimen, not a fixed-dose combination).

quote: Systemic lupus erythematosus
note: Single-ingredient dexamethasone label lists SLE.

quote: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) in adults and pediatric patients 6 years and older
note: Single-ingredient text covers ADHD, of which the inattentive type is a subtype.

quote: mycosis fungoides
note: Single-ingredient prednisone label lists mycosis fungoides; refractory MF is a subtype.

quote: For the relief of symptoms of depression.
note: Single-ingredient amitriptyline is indicated for depression, which covers perinatal depression as a subtype.

quote: Acetaminophen Injection is indicated for the management of mild to moderate pain
note: Single-ingredient acetaminophen covers general pain including minor pain of arthritis, which encompasses inflammatory pain.

quote: pure red cell aplasia
note: Single-ingredient dexamethasone label lists pure red cell aplasia.

quote: TIVICAY and TIVICAY PD are indicated in combination with other antiretroviral agents for the treatment of HIV‑1 infection
note: Single-ingredient dolutegravir (Tivicay) and EMA text cover HIV-1 infection.

quote: FOLIC ACID oral solution is indicated for the treatment of megaloblastic anemias due to folic acid deficiency
note: Single-ingredient folic acid label covers megaloblastic anemia.

quote: TRADJENTA is indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus
note: Single-ingredient linagliptin label and EMA text cover T2DM.

quote: COLCRYS (colchicine, USP) tablets are indicated in adults and children 4 years or older for treatment of familial Mediterranean fever (FMF)
note: Single-ingredient colchicine label covers FMF.

quote: Keratitis
note: Single-ingredient hydrocortisone label lists keratitis under ophthalmic diseases.

quote: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), including chronic bronchitis and emphysema
note: Single-ingredient formoterol label covers COPD including chronic bronchitis.

quote: Tadalafil Tablets are indicated for the treatment of erectile dysfunction (ED).
note: Single-ingredient tadalafil label and EMA text cover ED.

quote: Optic neuritis
note: Single-ingredient prednisone label lists optic neuritis.

quote: in the treatment or prevention of various types of euthyroid goiters, including thyroid nodules, subacute or chronic lymphocytic thyroiditis (Hashimoto’s)
note: Only the thyroid-hormone (T4/T3) combination text supports it, via TSH suppression that levothyroxine itself provides, so not co-ingredient-derived; note the single-ingredient labels explicitly exclude transient hypothyroidism in subacute thyroiditis (borderline).

quote: Prophylaxis and treatment of venous thrombosis and pulmonary embolism
note: Single-ingredient heparin label covers pulmonary embolism.

quote: indicated for the treatment of the symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis in adults and pediatric patients 5 years and older
note: Single-ingredient azelastine label covers seasonal allergic rhinitis.

quote: iritis, cyclitis
note: Single-ingredient loteprednol covers iritis/cyclitis (anterior uveitis forms), and the loteprednol/tobramycin label's 'chronic anterior uveitis' is a steroid indication attributable to loteprednol, not tobramycin.

quote: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), including chronic bronchitis and/or emphysema
note: Single-ingredient olodaterol (Striverdi) label covers COPD including chronic bronchitis.

quote: Urinary Tract Infections (UTI)
note: Single-ingredient ciprofloxacin label covers urinary tract infections.

quote: Severe psoriasis.
note: Single-ingredient corticotropin label lists severe psoriasis.

quote: Rheumatoid arthritis, including juvenile rheumatoid arthritis
note: Single-ingredient dexamethasone label lists multiple arthritides (RA, psoriatic, osteoarthritis synovitis, gouty).

quote: INBRIJA is indicated for the intermittent treatment of OFF episodes in patients with Parkinson's disease
note: Single-ingredient levodopa (Inbrija) and EMA text cover Parkinson disease; levodopa is also the active component of the combinations.

quote: Seasonal or perennial allergic rhinitis
note: Single-ingredient dexamethasone label lists allergic rhinitis, a subtype of rhinitis.

quote: For the treatment of most athlete's foot (tinea pedis), jock itch (tinea cruris), ringworm (tinea corporis)
note: Single-ingredient miconazole OTC labels cover tinea infections.

quote: adult patients with advanced or metastatic gastric cancer, gastroesophageal junction cancer, and esophageal ade
note: Single-ingredient nivolumab label covers GEJ cancer.

quote: Upper respiratory infections caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae
note: Single-ingredient doxycycline label covers S. pneumoniae infections.

quote: reduces the rate of progression of nephropathy as measured by the occurrence of doubling of serum creatinine or end stage renal disease
note: Single-ingredient losartan supports ESRD only as a prevented outcome of diabetic nephropathy (not treatment of ESRD), but nothing is co-ingredient-derived.

quote: Reduce elevated total-C, LDL-C, and Apo B in boys and postmenarchal girls, 10 to 17 years of age with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia
note: Single-ingredient simvastatin label covers HeFH.

quote: Telmisartan tablets, USP are indicated for reduction of the risk of myocardial infarction, stroke, or death from cardiovascular causes
note: Single-ingredient telmisartan label covers MI risk reduction.

quote: psoriatic arthritis; rheumatoid arthritis
note: Single-ingredient prednisolone label lists psoriatic arthritis.

quote: damaged, ingrown and devitalized nails
note: Single-ingredient urea label covers damaged/ingrown/devitalized nails.

quote: localized hypertrophic, infiltrated, inflammatory lesions of granuloma annulare
note: Single-ingredient triamcinolone (Kenalog-10) label covers granuloma annulare.

quote: mild, uncomplicated allergic skin manifestations of urticaria and angioedema
note: Single-ingredient diphenhydramine label covers urticaria.

quote: KEYTRUDA is indicated for the treatment of patients with high-risk early-stage triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC)
note: Single-ingredient pembrolizumab label covers TNBC.

quote: mycosis fungoides
note: Single-ingredient prednisolone label lists mycosis fungoides.

quote: indicated for the treatment of ocular itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis
note: Single-ingredient olopatadine ophthalmic label covers ocular itching (pruritus).

quote: infections caused by Chlamydia trachomatis : conjunctivitis of the newborn
note: Single-ingredient erythromycin label covers chlamydial conjunctivitis of the newborn (neonatal inclusion conjunctivitis).

quote: Budesonide inhalation suspension is indicated for the maintenance treatment of asthma
note: Single-ingredient budesonide label covers asthma.

quote: For the treatment of dermatomyositis, temporal arteritis, polymyositis, and systemic lupus erythematosus.
note: Single-ingredient hydrocortisone label lists polymyositis.
